headline: Binance CEO Assures Asset Safety After Massive Hack, Promises Withdrawals
summary: Following a cyber exploit resulting in $6.3 billion in losses, Binance CEO Richard Teng assured users that their assets are secure, pledged company funds to cover losses, and promised to restore withdrawals.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange; major security breaches and liquidity commitments carry systemic implications for crypto asset prices, exchange trust, and regulatory scrutiny.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Massive security exploits on major crypto exchanges undermine market confidence and can trigger broader digital asset sell-offs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The massive scale of the cyber exploit raises immediate solvency and security concerns across digital asset markets, pressuring crypto valuations.
